Reviewed diff against ticket PMAT-4130 and receipt. The diff successfully resolves uncompilable integration tests and run-time contract includes for the four target crates (aprender-core, aprender-orchestrate, aprender-cbtop, aprender-test-showcase) without re-versioning any sibling dev-dependencies:
1. Integration test targets depending on path-only dev-dependencies or out-of-crate files are excluded in Cargo.toml using CB-510 root-anchored paths, allowing cargo to drop the targets during packaging while keeping them executable in the workspace.
2. aprender-core lib unit tests including repo-root contracts are converted to run-time resolution via test_support::workspace_contract_or_skip, panicking in-tree if missing/unreadable and skipping with an explicit column-0 message only when out-of-tree.
3. aprender-db/src/generated_contracts.rs is checked in identically to the 25 other crates, preventing build-time tree dirtying that caused cargo package failures.
4. All receipt claims were verified and measured: test_support unit tests pass (including panic on in-tree missing file), lib unit tests pass under both default and --features setfit without skipping, and check_include_files.sh passes with 1795 files. No regressions, scope creeps, or weakened gates found.

PMAT-4130 diff verified and passed. The four crates (aprender-core, aprender-orchestrate, aprender-cbtop, aprender-test-showcase) no longer ship uncompilable tests in their tarballs. Package excludes are root-anchored (CB-510), sibling dev-dependencies remain path-only (PMAT-955/R6), in-tree unit test contract reads panic on missing files and skip with explicit diagnostics out-of-tree, cargo package builds succeed without dirtying the working tree, and the tarball build gate confirms none of the four target crates are RED.
